review.noSeed: This demo material has no seeded content yet.
review.noSeedLink: Open "Summer personal loan, Meta feed ad" to see a full review

dialog.stillWaiting: {{groups}} must still approve. The material stays In review until every required group approves.
dialog.lastGroup: This is the last required group. Approving creates an approval ID and an expiry date.
dialog.openFindings_one: {{count}} finding is still open. Approving does not close it, and the finding stays in the record.
dialog.openFindings_other: {{count}} findings are still open. Approving does not close them, and the findings stay in the record.

approve.title: Approve
approve.label: Comment
approve.placeholder: For example: Checked the APR disclosure against D-7 v3.
approve.help: The owner and the audit log see this comment.

approve_conditions.title: Approve with conditions
approve_conditions.label: Conditions
approve_conditions.placeholder: For example: Run only in states where the HELOC offer is licensed.
approve_conditions.help: The owner must follow these conditions. Monitoring reports a broken condition as a live problem.

request_changes.title: Request changes
request_changes.label: What must change
request_changes.placeholder: For example: Add disclosure D-7 v3 after the payment amount.
request_changes.help: The owner gets this message and uploads a new version.

reject.title: Reject this version
reject.label: Reason
reject.placeholder: For example: The offer does not exist for this product.
reject.help: This version must not run. The owner can still submit a new version.

escalate.title: Escalate
escalate.description: Add a required group. The material stays In review until that group approves too.
escalate.label: Reason
escalate.placeholder: For example: The ad mentions home equity, so Mortgage must review it.
escalate.help: The new group sees this reason in their queue.

retract.title: Retract your approval
retract.label: Reason
retract.placeholder: For example: The rate sheet changed after I approved.
retract.help: Your groups count as waiting again. You can retract only your own approval.

override.label_one: {{count}} High finding is open. Approving needs an override reason.
override.label_other: {{count}} High findings are open. Approving needs an override reason.
override.placeholder: For example: The APR disclosure is in the image, which the code check does not read.
override.help: The audit log records this reason with your name.

history.note: The audit log is append-only. Nobody can edit or delete entries.

live.emptyBody: Monitoring has not found this material on its channel. After approval, monitoring compares the live content with the approved version and opens an issue for any difference.

match.similarity: Matched by similarity (a person must check)

live.noApproved: No approved version to compare with. This content was found live before anyone approved it.
live.changesSince: Live content, with changes since approved version {{version}}

changes.oldVersion: You are viewing version {{version}}, submitted by {{name}} on {{date}}. Findings, comments and decisions are on version {{current}}.

submit.intro: Add the content and the facts about where it runs. Pre-review starts as soon as you submit.
submit.versionIntro: This form starts with the current content. Change what you need, then submit version {{version}}. The reviewers see what changed.
submit.title: Title
submit.titlePlaceholder: For example: Spring auto loan, Meta feed ad
submit.textInImage: Image, and the text in it
submit.fileHint: Images or PDF. Each file becomes part of this version.
submit.contentUrlHelp: ClearPath saves a copy of the page now, so the review uses this exact content.
submit.chooseChannelFirst: Choose a channel first. The fields match what the channel shows.
submit.nationwideHelp: The checklist includes the rules of every state where ClearPath is licensed.
submit.statesHelp: Choose each state where this runs. The checklist adds each state’s rules.
submit.targetingPlaceholder: For example: Ages 25 to 54, interest in home improvement
submit.proofHint: Documents that prove claims in the content
submit.routingEmpty: Choose a product and states to see who reviews this.

errors.title: Add a title.
errors.states: Choose Nationwide or at least one state.
errors.endDate: The end date must be after the launch date.
